target.statement: The IQR-based commercial anomaly detection layer identifies 1,351 price anomalies, of which 1,288 (net weight >= 1.0 kg) are forwarded to the Customs Review queue.
target.dataset: UN Comtrade ODS-related trade records 2020-2022 (~100,000 rows)

compute.basis: No code is released, so the whole ingestion/cleaning/K-Means/IQR pipeline must be re-implemented from prose; the raw Comtrade extract (specific HS codes, reporters, years, filters) is not specified, so exact reproduction of the 1,351/1,288 counts is unlikely even though the compute itself is trivial on 100k rows.

blockers: Exact Comtrade query (HS codes, reporters, period, filters) not specified, so the 100k-row dataset cannot be reconstructed exactly
Counts depend on undocumented cleaning and per-HS-code IQR choices
title: Pattern Recognition of Ozone-Depleting Substance Exports in Global Trade Data
